summary: Playboy, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a stock repurchase agreement with affiliates of Fortress Investment Group. The company will repurchase 16,589,531 shares of common stock (100% of Fortress's beneficial ownership) at $1.05 per share, totaling $17.4 million, in four installments through end of 2026. The first $2 million cash installment was due on the effective date of June 18, 2026. The board and audit committee approved the agreement. After completion, Fortress will no longer be a significant stockholder or affiliate but will remain the primary senior secured lender. The repurchase reduces overhang from a large holder and may signal management's view of undervaluation. Watch for completion risk given installment structure and ongoing lender relationship.
